title: Chinese Troops

C. I. D.
A. O. R.
No. 695
Date 21/1/26

CHINESE TROOPS.

Now that disturbances in China are almost brought to an end, the authorities at Peking are contemplating to readjust the whole army. But nearly 200,000 troops having been newly enlisted in consequence of the Yunnan uprising, the task proves to be no easy undertaking. For the sake of reference, we here give the number of men in uniform whom China had prior to the late Revolution, by the side of the troops now in the service.
